query:
SELECT 
  sponsorId,
  timeSlot,
  attendeeNumber,
  COUNT(*) as meeting_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(attendeeId ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ', ') as attendee_ids
FROM meetings
WHERE timeSlot IS NOT NULL
  AND status IN ('suggested', 'confirmed')
GROUP BY sponsorId, timeSlot, attendeeNumber
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY sponsorId, timeSlot;
